cases.prompt: A person jogs forward slowly at an easy, relaxed pace with short light strides.
A person runs forward at a brisk steady pace with rhythmic arm swings and medium length strides.
A person sprints forward at high speed with powerful arm swings and long rapid strides.
A person standing upright bends both knees into a deep crouch, holds briefly, and rises back to a relaxed standing posture.
A person walks forward in a low crouch, keeping the knees deeply bent and the torso lowered while taking deliberate alternating steps.
A person crawls forward on hands and knees along the floor, alternating the arms and legs smoothly.
A person crawls forward very low along the floor on forearms and knees with the chest close to the ground.
A person stands still, raises the right hand and waves a friendly greeting, then lowers the hand to a relaxed standing posture.
A person stands still, extends the right arm to point clearly forward, holds the pointing gesture briefly, then lowers the arm.

A person performs one controlled judo forward shoulder roll diagonally across the back, tucking the head and rolling from one shoulder toward the opposite hip, then regains a balanced standing posture.

scope: Round2: text-conditioned full-speed generation, no playback speed substitution or new MotionBricks calls. Three seeds per behavior; actual source root speeds measured rather than assumed from prompt labels. Crawl/ukemi hand, knee, back contacts require visual review.
